subject: Cardinal HealthTech: geo-anchoring commitment & PrivateLink evidence
messages:
From: Eleni Papadopoulos <epapado@cardinalht.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:04:00 -0400
Subject: Geo-anchoring confirmation + PrivateLink evidence request

Hi Kimberly / Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement/security at Cardinal HealthTech needs us to provide explicit artifacts that confirm (1) production data for the CA-4921 pilot will be anchored in an EU-hosted deployment, and (2) connectivity will be via PrivateLink or a customer-managed VPC peering with no internet egress for sensitive payloads.

Can you share:
- A short cover note confirming the EU hosting commitment and which region(s) will host model inference and any persisted artifacts (KV cache, logs, metrics).
- SOC 2 snapshot or the specific control IDs that map to data locality and network isolation.
- A CAIQ/SIG map showing how Redwood's PrivateLink/VPC options satisfy Cardinal's control set.
- A network diagram or stub showing the PrivateLink/privatenet path and where KMS keys reside (region).

We need these items for our security review; target turnaround is EOD Monday (May 17). If any of this needs legal or procurement signoff from your side, call that out.

Appreciate it — Eleni

Eleni Papadopoulos
Head of Information Security, Cardinal HealthTech
epapado@cardinalht.com
+44 20 7946 3120

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Hi Rishi / Grace — forwarding Cardinal's ask. Short timeline (EOD Mon). Key asks are: EU hosting confirmation, SOC 2 control IDs for locality/network isolation, CAIQ mapping for our PrivateLink option, and a simple network diagram with KMS region.

Grace: can you lead the CAIQ/cover note? Rishi: can you produce the network diagram + SOC2 snapshot mapping (control ids)? I will assemble into a single packet and share the Drive link with Cardinal. If any item will take longer than Monday, flag now so I can set expectations.

Thanks — Kim

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Geo-anchoring confirmation + PrivateLink evidence request

Kim / Grace — on it. Quick technical notes for the packet:

- EU hosting: production inference containers for pilot CA-4921 will be pinned to eu-west-1 (Ireland). Persistent artifacts (evicted KV cache fragments, logs shipped for debugging) by default remain in that region; we can enable retention-only non-prod artifact forwarding to other regions as requested, but default is eu-west-1.

- KMS: customer-managed KMS options are supported; if Cardinal uses our managed keystore, CMKs are region-bound within eu-west-1. For private KMS/bring-your-own-key we will document the handshake and allowed key providers.

- Private connectivity: Redwood Private supports AWS PrivateLink and VPC peering depending on the customer's network posture. PrivateLink will keep ingress on the private AWS network; no public internet hop for tokenized inference requests.

I'll attach a diagram and a SOC2 snapshot. The CAIQ mapping is work for Grace to finalize (controls crosswalk). Expect my artifacts by EOD today.

Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Eleni Papadopoulos <epapado@cardinalht.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:46:00 -0400
Subject: Attachments: SOC2 snapshot + PrivateLink diagram (draft)

Kim / Grace / Eleni — attaching draft artifacts for initial review. Small notes in-line in the SOC2 snapshot about which control IDs tie to network segregation (CC6.1 / CC7.3 equivalents in our framework) and the retained artifact types.

Attachment stubs included:
- redwood_soc2_snapshot_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB) — redacted snapshot, highlights controls related to logical/physical separation and data locality.
- privatelink_network_diagram.png (PNG, 420KB) — draft diagram showing PrivateLink endpoint in eu-west-1, customer VPC, and KMS region callouts.

Eleni — quick point: the diagram shows default path when using Redwood-managed keystore. If Cardinal will BYOK and place the KMS outside eu-west-1, please let us know and we'll mark the change in the CAIQ crosswalk.

I'll hand off the CAIQ spreadsheet to Grace to map to Cardinal's SIG questions.

-r

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Eleni Papadopoulos <epapado@cardinalht.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: CAIQ mapping & final delivery plan for Monday

Eleni / Kim — attached is the CAIQ/SIG crosswalk tailored to Cardinal's questionnaire (sheet named 'Cardinal_SIG_Responses'). Highlights:

- Mapped SIG controls where PrivateLink + KMS region residency satisfy the requirement; rows with conditional language specify how BYOK or alternate KMS placement changes the control posture.
- Confirmed SOC2 control pointers included in the redwood_soc2_snapshot_v2.pdf.
- Delivery plan: we will publish a single evidence bundle to the Drive link below by 17:00 BST Monday (May 17): SOC2 snapshot (redacted), CAIQ crosswalk (Cardinal-specific), PrivateLink diagram, and a short two-paragraph cover letter confirming EU anchoring of production inference and default KMS residency in eu-west-1.

Drive link (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d-privatelink-evidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CA-4921

If anything in the CAIQ rows looks insufficient, send specific control IDs and we'll expand the narrative.

Grace

--

grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Eleni Papadopoulos <epapado@cardinalht.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 17:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Geo-anchoring confirmation + PrivateLink evidence request

Thanks Kim / Rishi / Grace — that looks good. A couple of quick clarifications before we close the review:

1) Please include an explicit line in the cover note: "Production inference traffic and persisted artifacts for the CA-4921 pilot will remain within eu-west-1 unless explicitly configured otherwise by Cardinal HealthTech."
2) On the CAIQ row that references KMS, add the fallback behaviour when BYOK keys are provided (we want to confirm that BYOK still preserves an in-region key usage pattern).
3) Provide one runbook snippet (1-2 paragraphs) describing the onboarding steps for establishing the PrivateLink endpoint and validating that no public egress exists.

If you can fold these three items into the packet by 17:00 BST tomorrow (May 18) we'll sign off and move to procurement signatures.

Eleni

Cardinal HealthTech — Security Review Team
